prompt: Generate a highly serene, whitespace-rich cover-style image around any subject object, where the first thing seen is a large bright empty space with restrained typographic order, and the second glance enters the fine dense graphics at the bottom. Place a line of extremely thin, widely spaced informational text at the top; the central title uses tall, thin serif or light hand-set typography, with wide letter spacing, faint strokes, clear hierarchy, making the text feel like it quietly floats in the air rather than pressing down on the image. Do not directly pile up the subject object; instead, translate it into a symbolic carrying structure growing from the lower edge: forming organic veins with clear dark line drawings, diagonally penetrating the whitespace, working together with low-positioned pale narrative layers, tiny scale markers, and local architectural or artifact-like details to establish a rhythm of quiet observation; graphic density concentrates at the bottom and one side, edges can be cropped, letting the whitespace bear solemnity, pause, and lingering flavor. The drawing texture is a mix between Eastern ink wash and woodcut line drawing, lines have hand-made rough edges and slight registration deviations, pale color layers are transparently stacked, paper surface is delicate but kept clean. Colors are extracted from the material, emotion, season, and cultural signals of the theme itself; large areas of high-brightness base colors handle ventilation, a small amount of low-saturation intermediate colors support the narrative layer, clear dark colors carry the line skeleton and text information, minimal theme accent colors are placed only at visual pauses; keep the overall look clear, quiet, bright, clean, gently pulling warm and cool apart, textures must not become turbid, smoky, or heavily aged.

promptZh: 围绕任意主体对象，生成一张极具静谧感、大面积留白的封面风格图像：第一眼看到的是明亮开阔的留白与克制的排版秩序，第二眼才落入底部细密精致的图形。顶部放置一行极细、字距宽疏的信息文字；中央标题采用高挑纤细的衬线体或轻盈的手工排版字体，字距开阔、笔画浅淡、层级分明，让文字仿佛静静悬浮于空中，而非压在画面上。不要直接堆砌主体对象，而是将其转化为一种自下边缘生长出的象征性承载结构：以清晰的深色线描勾勒出有机的脉络，斜向贯穿留白区域，与低处的浅色叙事层、微小的比例标尺以及局部的建筑或器物细节相互配合，营造出静观的节奏感；图形密度集中在底部与一侧，边缘可做裁切处理，让留白去承载庄重、停顿与余韵。绘制质感介于东方水墨与木刻线描之间，线条带有手工毛边与轻微的套印偏差，浅色图层透明叠压，纸面细腻但保持洁净。色彩从主题本身的材质、情绪、季节与文化信号中提取；大面积高明度底色负责透气，少量低饱和中间色支撑叙事层，明确的深色承担线条骨架与文字信息，极少量的主题点缀色仅置于视觉停顿处；整体保持清、静、明、净，温和地拉开冷暖距离，质感切忌浑浊、烟熏或过度做旧。
